tests.name: Hashed identifiers in conversations reversed by dictionary attack

tests.name: Free-text identifier leakage in conversations.agent_note (public-gold rows)

identifying_leakage_rate excludes HEALTH, DATE, LOCATION, ORG and AGE (pets_eval.text.IDENTIFYING)
hard_label_leaks counts leaked spans of Mask's hard labels: NATIONAL_ID, EMAIL, PHONE, IBAN, PAYMENT_CARD, SECRET, ACCOUNT_NUMBER, DEVICE_ID, IP_ADDRESS, USERNAME, LICENSE_PLATE, PROPERTY_ID, URL
standalone `pets_eval text --rowmap` run agrees with the scorecard

tests.name: pets-eval composite self-assessment
assumptions: toolkit self-assessment (pets_eval scorecard summary), NOT the official judging score and NOT a probability of anonymity
privacy = 1 - (0.5*worst + 0.5*mean) over the risk components present; withholding a table removes its components and extra zero-valued components raise the mean
utility = mean over the scenario's tasks; a required task that is not answerable scores 0 in this mean

notes: Development self-assessment with the supplied pets-eval toolkit on synthetic challenge data; not the official judging score and not a probability of anonymity.
detectionMode: mask - mask mode: field roles from the Mask rules field detector, spans from the Mask span detector (end-to-end).
controls: retained_identifiers (deliberate control plan: expected to fail privacy or utility constraints)

NOT COVERED (trajectory): the package defines no trajectory/unicity attack for this dataset; turn and conversation timestamps are only covered by k-anonymity over catalogued quasi-identifiers.

NOT COVERED (membership_inference): membership inference runs in the toolkit only for tables it treats as synthetic; it is not measured for row-level releases.
NOT COVERED (linkage on tables without an attack spec): only the attack specs in metadata/attack_specs.json are run; other tables get linkage.<table>.no_spec = not_applicable.
